_about: Deck half of the bake-off: fit and speed, measured on the device. One entry per model per date. Fill by hand from the run files; the report generator reads it. Leave 'runs' empty until the Deck half has run.

fields.tag: Ollama tag as installed on the Deck
fields.game_running: name of the game running during the measurement, or 'none'
fields.loads: true if the model loaded beside that game without the game stuttering
fields.load_s: seconds from Ask to the first thinking or answer chunk on a cold model
fields.first_word_s: seconds to the first answer word, thinking Off, warm model
fields.words_per_s: answer words per second, thinking Off
fields.thinking_s_balanced: seconds of thinking at the Balanced level
fields.note: anything a person would want to know
